details:
This update for prometheus-blackbox_exporter fixes the following issues:

Changes in prometheus-blackbox_exporter:

- CVE-2026-84304: Fix heap memory exhaustion (OOM) via HTTP/2 DATA
                  frame fragmentation in gRPC-Go by bumping it to
                  version 1.83.1 (bsc#1279126)

- CVE-2026-39821: Fix potential validation bypass and privilege
                  escalation by bumping golang.org/x/net to version
                  0.57.0 (bsc#1266556)

- CVE-2026-39821: Bump golang.org/x/net to version 0.55.0 (bsc#1266556)

- Build only for SUSE distributions

- Upgrade to version 0.26.0 (jsc#PED-12872):
  * Changes:
    Replace go-kit/log with log/slog module.
  * Features:
    Add metric to record tls ciphersuite negotiated during
      handshake.
    Add a way to export labels with content matched by the probe.
    Reports Certificate Serial number.
  * Enhancement:
    Add stale workflow to start sync with stale.yaml in Prometheus.
  * Bug fixes:
    Only register grpc TLS metrics on successful handshake.

- Upgrade to version 0.25.0:
  * Features:
    Allow to get Probe logs by target.
    Log errors from probe.
  * Bug fixes:
    Prevent logging confusing error message.
    Explicit registration of internal exporter metrics.

- Security:
  * CVE-2025-22870: Fix proxy bypassing using IPv6 zone IDs (bsc#1238680)
  * CVE-2023-45288: Fix closing connections when receiving too many headers (bsc#1236515)
